measurementMeaning: Every active _process call is sampled; five seconds control JSON window emission only. This is not a display presentation timeline.
renderer: Android Emulator OpenGL ES Translator (llvmpipe (LLVM 20.1.2, 256 bits))
limits: Original2029 diagnostic; not a new2031 Android result.
TIME_PROCESS is a monitor value, not CPU utilization or per-function profiling.
No justified individual mesh/effect/JNI bottleneck attribution from these aggregate data.
High per-window percentiles with5or6samples do not establish global tail latency.
Accepted native audible status is not an acoustic recording or human listening test.
review: Independent source and original-artifact review; root checked exact pinned source bytes and independently recomputed weighted metrics. No native optimization or test rerun made from unsupported attribution.
